title: SSC CPO 2023 Tier-1 Art & Culture PART-1

questions.question:
Identify the cultural festival on the basis of given clues:
i) This festival brings together craftsmen like potters, embroiderers, weavers, wood carvers, metal workers, stone smiths and painters from all over India on one platform in Haryana.
ii) This crafts mela is held in February every year and provides a glimpse of the state’s cultural heritage and recent achievements.

Moatsu festival of Nagaland is celebrated by which of the following tribes?
Ker and Garia Puja are traditional tribal festivals of which state?
Losar (a new year festival) is celebrated in which of the following states?
Which Goddess is associated with the Gangaur Festival celebrated in Central and Western India?
In which of the following states is Bonalu festival celebrated?
Which of the following cultural festivals of South India is associated with the folklore of King Mahabali?
Rongker festival is celebrated by which of the following tribes?
